correctness.rationale: For connected simple unit-weight graph, P=BL^dagger B^T is a symmetric projector. On a nonbridge edge, deleting it and using the harmonic unit voltage h gives electrical conductance c>0 and total variation T, with absolute projector row sum (1+T)/(1+c). Simplicity yields T>=1 and T>=2c, minimizing at c=1/2 gives the exact 4/3 gap. Equality forces a single two-edge alternative path, hence every cyclic edge lies in a unique triangle and the entire graph is triangular cactus; orthogonal cycle indicators produce norm max(1,2-2/ell) on all cacti. Independent matrix-pseudoinverse calculations tested every 971 connected cyclic atlas graph on 3..7 vertices with precisely 46 equality graphs.
